windows_rows_provenance.path_note: runs.<name>.aligned.windows_rows names windows_<bundle>.csv; when only windows_<bundle>.csv.gz exists the runner reads that (load_aligned) and runs.<name>.input_sha256 holds its hash
windows_rows_provenance.label_independence: the columns read do not depend on E3's judgment labels (labels only score AB0), so rows from an E3 pass on an older label version serve any label version, provided the vision commit and the inputs are the same; equal_to_e3_current_rows checks this per file
